plugins.name: Google Calendar
plugins.description: Your Google Calendar as a day strip and a today timeline, with invitations to answer (Accept / Maybe / Decline), tomorrow and upcoming events, and reminders with a sound you choose and a Join click for Meet. One account per project through your own OAuth client (the panel walks you through it); the Jira issue beside an event that names one. Needs cc-cockpit 0.9.4 or later; 0.9.5 for reminder sounds and Join.
plugins.author: BronOS

plugins.name: Google Chat
plugins.description: Your Google Chat in lanes (Mentions, Direct messages, Spaces, Alerts, Recent) for a Google Workspace account, one account per project through your own OAuth client (the panel walks you through it). Mark read and unread; open a conversation as a page, annotate it and discuss it with Claude. Sorted by priority when Jev triage (bronos.jev-triage) is installed. Needs cc-cockpit 0.9.2 or later; 0.9.4 opens conversations at the newest message.
plugins.author: BronOS

plugins.name: Gmail
plugins.description: Your Gmail in lanes (Unread, Alerts with Grafana grouping, Read), read-only, one Google account per project through your own OAuth client (the panel walks you through it). Open a thread as a clean page with its images, annotate it and discuss it with Claude. Sorted by priority when Jev triage (bronos.jev-triage) is installed. With the Jira plugin, a mail from Jira shows its issue side by side (cc-cockpit 0.9.3) and is triaged by the issue. Needs cc-cockpit 0.9.1 or later; 0.9.2 recommended.
plugins.author: BronOS

plugins.name: Inbox
plugins.description: One panel with everything that needs you, from every plugin that offers an inbox feed (Google Chat, Gmail and Jira today), ranked by your own rules, with done, snooze and undo, a Read list to reopen what you already read, and today's calendar as a strip with the next meeting and Join (with the Calendar plugin). No account and no network calls of its own: it reads the other plugins through their services. Needs cc-cockpit 0.9.7 or later, and Chat 0.2.0, Gmail 0.4.0, Jira 0.6.0 or Calendar 0.2.0 as sources.
plugins.author: BronOS

plugins.name: Jev triage
plugins.description: Requires the Jev plugin (bronos.jev). The "triage" plugin service for source plugins (mail, Jira, chat): a priority (urgent, action, fyi, noise) and a kind per item, judged by Jev, with per-project rules, a profile of what you own, your corrections, and an improve loop that turns a wrong verdict into a better rule or profile in a Claude tab.
plugins.author: BronOS

plugins.name: Jev
plugins.description: Jev, TypeSafe's cheap typed classifier, as the "jev" plugin service: other plugins ask choice, yes/no and score questions (one request, or a grid over many items). OpenRouter, TypeSafe direct or a custom endpoint; usage counted per calling plugin, with a monthly spending cap. Choices only, no free-form text generation.
plugins.author: BronOS

plugins.name: Jira
plugins.description: Your Jira Cloud issues in lanes (Backlog, In progress, Mentioned, On hold, Done) with unread marks, read-only towards Jira. Open an issue as a styled page with its images, annotate it and discuss it with Claude in the current tab or a new one. Sorted by priority when Jev triage (bronos.jev-triage) is installed; annotating needs cc-cockpit 0.8.0 or later.
plugins.author: BronOS

plugins.name: Example
plugins.description: A click counter to copy as a starting point for your own plugin. One panel, one setting, one command.
plugins.author: BronOS
